title: worker.sh consumes TICKS_ROLE_PROMPT so a cloud worker runs on the profile's prompt
description: From ticfac yoh finding 55f3f8d2 (9iz, high). ticfac's dispatch door now carries the rendered role prompt to the worker container as TICKS_ROLE_PROMPT (yoh tick 9iz), but cloud/sandbox/worker.sh builds its own prompt and ignores it, so a cloud worker never runs on the profile's prompt. worker.sh should use TICKS_ROLE_PROMPT when set (falling back to today's prompt when absent, for older factories), with a test in internal/sandbox.
acceptance_criteria: worker.sh runs the harness on TICKS_ROLE_PROMPT when it is set and on today's prompt when it is not; internal/sandbox tests cover both; README documents the variable
